transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um... I guess things have just gotten kind of bad at home. I... I spend most of my day just going back over the same things. The outlets, the locks... my tools. Even just dust in the house. I just keep checking and fixing them. Again and again. 

I get completely worn out, but... I just never feel sure enough to leave it alone. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.

When you're checking the outlets, locks, or cleaning, do you have thoughts that keep coming up that you don't want or that bother you, like a fear something bad will happen if you don't do it just right?

Yeah. Um... I guess so. It's... I don't really like talking about it. But... even when I know I did a job right, these... just ugly thoughts keep jumping in. 

Like... maybe there's a loose wire I missed, and it's gonna burn the house down. Or... a nail I left out somewhere is gonna hurt my wife. I try to just... push them out of my head, but... they just come right back. Stronger. So... yeah.

The patient also reports significant distress and possible impairment, which could also be consistent with adjustment disorder with anxiety and depressed mood (F43.22) or a major depressive episode (F32.9), as mood symptoms may co-occur with anxiety or OCD. No definitive exclusion yet possible.
